mapper.select: select t.`field_id` AS fieldId, t.`field_code` AS fieldCode, t.`field_name` AS fieldName, t.`field_title` AS fieldTitle, t.`is_measure` AS isMeasure, t.`ctg_id` AS ctgId, t.`ctg_name` AS ctgName, t.`query_count` AS queryCount, t.`query_user_count` AS queryUserCount, DATE_FORMAT(t.`min_query_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS minQueryTime, DATE_FORMAT(t.`max_query_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS maxQueryTime, t.`sort_id` AS sortId from `ssd_query_field_stats_total` t order by t.`ctg_id`, t.`sort_id` ASC
